summary: On paper Washington has the edge (Washington's defense ranks 6th in explosive play rate, 7.9% allowed), while Philadelphia's best counter is to finish drives (Philadelphia ranks 2nd in red-zone TD rate, 62%). Under center, Jayden Daniels ranks 16th of 30 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: DeVonta Smith gives back 1.7 yards after the catch vs. expected, and Washington's defense ranks 9th in YAC allowed over expected. The model favors Washington at 65%, mostly on home field (1.6 pts) and starting QB (1.0 pts).
